Interface BuildingVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
BuildingTypesTest.VisitorProbe, EndGameVisitor, HuntEventVisitor, ImmediateVisitor, InventorsVisitor, PaintEventVisitor, SetVisitor, ShamanBonusEventVisitor, ShamanMalusEventVisitor, SustenanceEventVisitor
public interface BuildingVisitor
Interface that implements the Visitor pattern for different types of buildings. It provides an empty default implementation for each visit method.
